scope: Correction of the ERC-20 state below the Extended start seeded on 2026-10-29 from the RPC-era databases, in <chain>:evm-balances-erc20@v0.7.4 on cluster C. Every row current below S was read with balanceOf at S-1; differing rows were rewritten in place and their history bars in the S-1 windows deleted and rebuilt through the materialized view, with the live sinks running. Procedure: erc20/balances/clickhouse/examples/repair-pre-start-seed.

arbitrum-one.reads: S-1 for 660,316 pairs (29%), the rest at head block 521,009,827; the 60,417 pairs differing at head read at S-1; 18,308 of 62,827 differing rows read again at their own block, the other 44,519 moved to S-1 without it (ROW_READ=0)
arbitrum-one.corrected_rows_read_back_at_their_block: 31 of 31 equal (spot.py, 25 random plus 3 of each case)
arbitrum-one.applied: 2026-11-04: bars mutation submitted about 05:00 UTC and finished on both replicas before 14:46 UTC; rows, verify and drop after it

db_after.note: one receipt_block row shares its block number with the seeded row it replaces; FINAL returns the corrected value on both replicas, and the older row goes at the next merge

check_rows.sample: 1000 random seeded pairs (seed 20261103), current row against balanceOf at S-1

optimism.reads: S-1 for every pair; 27,115 differing rows of tokens with at most 1,000 differing rows read again at their own block, none already holding the final value
optimism.corrected_rows_read_back_at_their_block: 31 of 31 equal (spot.py, 25 random plus 3 of each case)
optimism.applied: 2026-11-04, with the revised apply.sh (bars submitted without waiting)

not_covered: Arbitrum One: 15,729 rows right at S-1 whose balance changed after S without a package row, in 152 tokens, mostly interest-bearing and rebasing tokens such as Aave v3 aTokens (computed balances, outside the package's design)
Rows whose balanceOf call returned no word at S-1 (Arbitrum One 122, Optimism 20,368) were left as seeded
Optimism: balances carried through the November 2021 regenesis without events (USDT, bridged USDC, DAI, WBTC supply gaps) are in neither database; the seed could not hold them
History bars of corrected pairs outside the S-1 windows keep the RPC era's values; balances are unaffected
